system.name: N3DNet (trained with RA-DQN)
system.one_liner: An all-optical nonlinear diffractive network for image denoising at the speed of light, whose layer phases are tuned by a regularization-assisted deep Q-network.

content.variant_note: an optical network as the environment and an RL agent that reads its phases and loss and returns phase updates
content.argues: The diffractive denoiser is trained as an environment by a deep-Q agent: phases are the state, the loss gives the reward, phase changes are the actions.
content.subject: A 3D-rendered stack of diffractive and nonlinear layers with noisy inputs and denoised outputs, and the RL agent with Q table and deep network that trains it.

lessons.what_to_learn: Frame a learned optimiser and the system it tunes as agent and environment: one heavy-bordered region for the system, one for the learner, three colour-matched arrows for state, reward and action, and the action arrow routed round the bottom to close the loop.
lessons.suits: Methods where reinforcement learning or search tunes parameters of a physical or simulated system, such as optics, control or design automation.

evidence: Caption: schematic of N3DNet on a mode image denoising example, trained with the RA-DQN algorithm.
Introduction: a nonlinear PEL activation follows each phase modulation layer of the network.

summary: The paper builds an all-optical diffractive network, N3DNet, that denoises images at the speed of light, with a pre-denoising module and a nonlinear activation after each diffractive layer, trained by a new reinforcement-learning algorithm, RA-DQN. Figure 1 frames training as environment and agent. A red frame shows the optical network as a 3D render: noisy mode images enter through coloured light cones, cross M translucent diffractive layers with yellow nonlinear layers between, and leave as denoised outputs, followed by a phase-grid box and an outputs-versus-targets box with a loss. A purple frame holds the agent: states, a Q table, a deep network, rewards and actions. Green arrows carry state, reward and action, and the action arrow returns round the bottom to the layers.
summary_zh: 提出全光非线性衍射去噪网络N3DNet，并用强化学习算法RA-DQN训练。图中左侧红框为光学网络的3D渲染图（带噪输入、M层衍射层与非线性激活层、去噪输出、相位网格与损失），右侧紫框为智能体，绿色箭头传递状态、奖励与动作。
notes: The arrow tails into Grid phase and Outputs / Targets start from the output column, so it is not certain whether the state is read from the outputs or from the layers; the record keeps the drawn tails. The pre-screen call of actor-interaction plus model-anatomy is kept. The bottom caption text is partly cropped into the preview and was ignored.
